key_insight: Simultaneous neural topology optimization jointly optimizes state, adjoint, and design networks to produce high-resolution stress-constrained designs while scaling across GPUs.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets lower-material structural designs under stress limits while addressing the computational demands of large-scale topology optimization.
method: Jointly train custom neural networks using continuous adjoint analysis and automatic differentiation.
Combine the design objective, aggregated local stress constraints, and potential energy functionals in one loss.
Distribute spatial partitions across GPUs and accumulate gradients over smaller slices to control peak memory without additional interface-loss terms.
evidence_signal: On 2D benchmarks, SNTO produced sharper boundaries, smaller gray areas, and lower volume fractions than a conventional finite element-based approach; 3D demonstrations reached eight million collocation points on up to eight GPUs.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify runtime savings or local stress-constraint violations, leaving computational efficiency and constraint fidelity to be assessed.
paper_title: Scalable Stress-Constrained Topology Optimization: A Super-resolution and Simultaneous Approach Based on Machine Learning
